title: Evidence Chain Before Entry
youtube_title: Evidence Chain Before Entry: Verify Before You Trade
youtube_description: A paper-trading process should verify the evidence chain before treating a setup as eligible: completed bars, source scope, fresh quotes, liquidity and intraday confirmation. Paper-trading education only; not live-money performance; not investment advice; no guaranteed returns.

improvement: Compared with the previous three releases, this short makes the evidence chain explicit in the first two scenes and uses a stronger stand-down conclusion when any required verification step is missing.

scenes.title: Start with the timestamp
scenes.narration: Before a setup can be reviewed, check when the underlying evidence was created.

scenes.title: Use completed bars
scenes.narration: Use completed, timestamped bars. An unfinished candle can change before the session is over.

scenes.title: Know the route
scenes.narration: Confirm the data source and the market scope. Different routes can show different evidence.

scenes.title: Find missing pieces
scenes.narration: Look for stale quotes, missing history or material gaps before interpreting a setup.

scenes.title: Require confirmation
scenes.narration: Only after freshness, liquidity and intraday confirmation are checked should a setup be considered eligible for further review.

scenes.title: Pause when unclear
scenes.narration: If the evidence chain cannot be verified, standing down is the disciplined result.
